pages.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: 1. Earn the other 54 trophies on this list. 2. This one unlocks automatically the moment the 54th lands — there is no separate task. 3. No multiplayer or DLC is needed: every trophy is single-player. 4. Plan around the one potentially missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude) and the long 100% checklist, since those are the only things that can slow the platinum down.

claims.text: The trophy is named Vice Got a Price!
Its official description is: Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend.
Its grade is platinum, the only platinum in the set.
It unlocks by earning all 54 other trophies.
No multiplayer and no DLC is required for it.
The platinum takes roughly 200 hours in total.
The trophy is visible on the list, not hidden.
Using cheats disables trophies and saving, so keep them off for a trophy run.
PowerPyx breaks the roughly 200 hours into 60-80 hours of story, about 100 hours of checklist and about 10 hours of cleanup.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 1. Finish the story first: the 100% checklist only becomes viewable afterwards, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts. 2. Work the checklist in free-roam: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK locations, all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal gang operations, all 15 Target Decks and Bret's quests. 3. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and the true completion behind it is closer to 60% of the game — most side quests and collectible types are not required at all. 4. This is the hardest trophy on the list and the bulk of the roughly 200-hour platinum.

claims.text: The trophy is named A Long Road.
Its official description is: Attain 100% Completion.
Its grade is gold, one of only two gold trophies.
It is visible on the list, not hidden.
The 100% checklist unlocks after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Progress made during the story already counts toward the checklist.
100% needs any 100 optional missions; there are far more than 100 in total.
100% needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned.
100% needs 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars.
100% needs only 15 of 18 meditations.
100% needs 70 of 80 challenges, so the hardest ones can be skipped.
100% needs 300 stunts, all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal gang operations and all 15 Target Decks.
Nothing toward 100% is missable; everything is doable after the story in free-roam.
The checklist is closer to 60% true completion, not a literal 100% of the game.
A Long Road is the hardest trophy on the list.
100% needs 15 complete card sets out of 18 in total.

Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. 3. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. 4. Note that 100% completion wants 300 stunts, so this trophy is a milestone on the way there, not the end of it.

Check the counter under Touchpad, Progress, Activities — scrolling over a type shows how many you have done. 3. Most types are introduced automatically by the story, and the rest get marked when you unfog the map; filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon). 4. You will likely finish this without trying while working on the other trophies.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: 1. Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations — meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2, and the last spot needs both characters together (unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break). 2. DO THIS FIRST: the one potentially missable meditation is in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. 3. That balcony meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save. 4. Track spots under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. 5. For 100% completion only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so this trophy is stricter than the checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: 1. Wait until after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break — that is when you can free-roam together as Jason and Lucia; call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. 2. Cause carnage until you reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you. 3. Escape: a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works well, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good route — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you there. 4. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area. 5. You will also get this automatically while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4, which always give 4 stars.

Free-roaming together as Jason and Lucia unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
A 4-star wanted level is needed, with the partner present.
The trophy unlocks after leaving the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: 1. Wait until after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters and call your partner. 2. With your partner beside you, rob 3 robbery targets in a row (green map icons) while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red and blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. 3. Gear up first: an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. 4. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City (available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): rob a couple of items in each, and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. 5. The unlock is delayed — it pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: 1. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle, hold R1 to scan). 2. Discover any 100 vehicles — the game has 557 vehicles at launch across cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. 3. The fastest way is to stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by; you only need to scan a vehicle, never drive it. 4. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles. 5. For 100% completion you need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy lands on the way there.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: 1. Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. 2. You must kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in a single activation, which only lasts a few seconds. 3. Prepare first: buff focus with food, drinks or a wash, and consume Adrenaline to extend Combat Focus; wear body armor so you can step out of cover. 4. Line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them fast without missing; an assault rifle like the Duke 556 is more accurate than pistols and SMGs. 5. Note that it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. 6. Focus has 4 levels and rises by doing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier later in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: 1. Go to VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane sitting on the airfield. 2. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight to it, and use the stairs with a door next to the boarding bridge to get inside (or walk in through the terminal on foot). 3. Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off. 4. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the unlock is slightly delayed until you are that far.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: 1. Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. 2. The tanks stand in the south of the air base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. 3. Enter a Rhino tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: 1. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies (green icons on unfogged map areas). 2. Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — never kick the door, which triggers the alarm. The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently. 3. Inside the backroom, find the note with the safe code, use it to loot the safe, and destroy the security footage and disable the alarm while you are there. 4. Leave and the trophy pops shortly after. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: 1. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies. 2. In the mission, tail a security van to a bank, wait for a guard to carry a briefcase of cash in and open the vault, then go in while it is open and rob it; bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone. 3. After that quest, pay Yasmani (fence, unlocked in Chapter 3) for tips about security vans — $10,000 a tip, after his earlier quests (robbing 2 Payday Loans) — and follow the purple-marked vans to more banks. 4. Rob any 5 vaults and escape each time; every vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so use a fast motorcycle and then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. 5. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and 100% needs all 8, so this trophy lands on the way there; a single bank can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: 1. The easy way: do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the vault of a large bank automatically counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank first. 2. The early way: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks. Block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani unlocks as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). 3. Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius — or use a Pay 'n' Spray. 4. All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100% anyway, so this comes automatically in the endgame.

trophies.guide: 1. Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. 2. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that still shows black fog until the entire map is visible.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: 1. Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — there are 39 illegal gang operations in total, but one per gang is enough for the trophy. 2. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. 3. Track per-gang progress under Progress, Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed, bottom right. 4. For 100% completion you need all 39, so this trophy lands on the way there.

Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and steal the blue Banshee — only the blue one works, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. 3. Hack into the car with the Key Cloner, then drive forward straight through the showroom window. 4. Drive away down the street; the unlock pops slightly delayed, after you have driven further away.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: 1. Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations — during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which marks it automatically. 2. Inside, steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon), the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the north-east hallway office — enter code 0300 or blow it up with sticky bombs. 3. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing enemies is not needed. 4. Not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can come back for the remaining valuables — they do not all need to be stolen in one go.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: 1. Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time — check Strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, select a character, scroll to Strength (heart icon). 2. You can only start after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. 3. Raise Strength by working out: buy a fitness club membership and always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner) — while one works out, the other automatically completes their training too, so you make double progress. 4. Filter for fitness clubs on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 1. Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — you can see how many of the 500 you have done by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. 2. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On): every time you do something that affects your reputation, a little demon face appears on the right of the screen. 3. The five profile tiers are Professional (stealthy objectives and robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing many cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable (permanent, from excessive violence — avoid it, since cops shoot on sight more). 4. It happens passively while working on all other trophies and the 100% checklist — every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it is still missing at the end, it can be farmed by running over civilians and cops with a car, though that pushes the profile toward Psycho or Irredeemable.

trophies.guide: 1. In the Prologue, Lucia robs a Payday Loans store. 2. Come back later and rob the same store again as Lucia — the earliest chance is after the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check, Meet Raul's Crew, which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. 3. Go to the Payday Loans in Vice City, Little Cuba, alone as Lucia without Jason. 4. Aim at the teller, take out the security, break through the door and steal from the 3 cash drawers. 5. Then run away on foot, not in a vehicle: escape the police search area and keep running until the trophy unlocks, delayed — it only unlocks on foot.

trophies.guide: 1. Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, on your own. 2. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside. 3. If the car is there, follow the path into the woods and look for the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. 4. Approach the UFO and it drops the woman it abducted. 5. Talk to her and offer to help; she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. 6. Go back to her car and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: 1. Get on any bike. 2. Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds — crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach work best. 3. The trophy unlocks once the tenth kick lands — ten kicks with Square within 60 seconds is the whole requirement.

Deliver a total of $250,000 in marked bills across all robberies; it does not need to be $250,000 at once. 4. It comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery (unlocked after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…).

It comes naturally over a full playthrough; if it is still short at the end, buy car mods or tattoos until it pops.

Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses); you get a notification that a new phone app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed, and you buy the garages through that app. 4. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. 5. Garages also add parking spots for On the Spot, so buy them before registering vehicles.

Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage click Respray and Register. 4. Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. 5. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes if you want to keep expenses low.
